# Witchard House Clearance

> Family-run house clearance specialists based in New Alresford, Hampshire, UK.

## What We Do

Witchard House Clearance provides full and partial property clearance services across Hampshire. We are an upper tier Environment Agency registered waste carrier (CBDU640764), CRB checked, and fully insured.

## Services

- Full House Clearance — complete end-to-end clearance of any property
- Partial Clearance — specific rooms or items only
- Post-Clearance Cleaning — full property clean after clearance (oven not included)
- Probate & Estate Clearance — sensitive handling of deceased persons' belongings
- Landlord & Rental Clearance — swift clearance after tenants vacate
- Garden & Garage Clearance — sheds, outbuildings, and exterior spaces

New Alresford, Old Alresford, Winchester, Eastleigh, Basingstoke, Alton, Petersfield, Southampton, Fareham, Romsey, Chandler's Ford, Bishop's Waltham, Hedge End, Whitchurch, Andover, Stockbridge

## Credentials

- EA Waste Carrier Registration: CBDU640764 (Upper Tier, expires May 2029)
- CRB checked staff
- Full public liability insurance
- Free no-obligation quotes

## Pricing

Prices vary by property size and volume. Approximate starting points:
- Single room / partial clearance: from a few hundred pounds
- Full clearance: price confirmed at free property assessment visit
- All quotes are free with no obligation
